rules.rule: No gloss, glow, drop shadow, outline, gradient, metallic or busy texture on any type, panel, rule, button or icon.
No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons or icons, apart from the sitter ground.
Every palette colour solid at 100% opacity (no tint); no scrim, gradient or overlay over a photograph.
Cascadia Slate and Warm Paper are mandatory colours.
Grounds and panels are Warm Paper or Cascadia Slate and nothing else, apart from the sitter ground.
On Warm Paper all type is Near Black apart from a Signal Copper affiliation line; on Cascadia Slate all type is Warm Paper or Fog Grey.
Signal Copper and Evergreen are accents only (thin rules, dividers, a Copper affiliation line), together no more than 5% of the designed area.
The CFS mark is Fog Grey on Cascadia Slate.
The ground behind each sitter is a tone within the Fog Grey #D9DDDE to Warm Paper #F2EEE7 range, replacing the photo background.
The sitter ground is soft and even, never a coloured or busy background.
One scale of head in frame across all eighteen portrait cards.
